beats.care: Going? Use the parking spots and avoid driving onto Tank Bund. In Kukatpally, IDL Lake roads have curbs from 5 pm to 11 pm.
beats.what: HMDA holds a Bathukamma Carnival at Tank Bund from 6 pm today, with Oggu Katha and Perini dance shows, plus food and handloom stalls.
beats.why: It is Saddula Bathukamma, the festival's final day, when huge crowds gather at lakes across the city.

cards.body: Traffic to Tank Bund from Telugu Thalli junction and Karbala Maidan is restricted. Iqbal Minar traffic goes via Telugu Thalli flyover, Indira Park and RTC X Roads. Parking is at Snow World, NTR Stadium, NTR Ghat, NTR Garden, HMDA Ground and Lumbini Park.
Traffic police say take Lucky Restaurant signal, KPHB 4th Phase and KPHB Road No. 1, or go via Rainbow Vista, Moosapet and Vasundhara Hospital to skip IDL Lake.
